tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_intake
tools.title: Prepare scoped DailyRecord intake and missing-only interview
tools.description:
Read qualified live DailyRecord before-state and prepare missing-only authoring interview. For name/today lookups prefer academy_dailyrecord_get; for explicit scope first resolve the name with academy_student_resolve. Requires current purpose/request, exact native teacher/student/date/namespace, selected fields, memo answer and facts. Use not_supplied and empty facts when none were supplied; never invent a memo answer or source codes. Configured owner backends are called live; sourceAvailability=observed proves the read even if status=interview_required for later authoring. Saved academy_source_status does not describe this backend. Observation handles are scoped to the exact student/date/request and remain fresh for at most 5 minutes from observedAt; a changed current/previous target, field values, sourceRevision, wireDigest or transmissionState causes source_before_or_contract_drift even within that window. Use fresh intake then review immediately before save after stale_source or drift; a different student save alone does not invalidate an unchanged target. Caller context is not authority. No writes or sending.

Academy routing context: DailyRecord 작성 전 기존 내용 확인·빠진 내용 인터뷰. Backend/source: DayRecordServlet and owner-qualified journal before-state. Read/prepare before-state. Use academy_dailyrecord_get for a plain lookup; intake is not server save or parent send.
End Academy routing context.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_review
tools.title: Review exact DailyRecord field differences without writing
tools.description:
Requires current user context. Reviews supplied parent text even without source, reporting unavailable before-state and no executable patch. A backend-issued observation handle additionally permits exact fresh before-state checks. Preserves existing entries, distinguishes no additional memo from deletion, checks supplied fact fragments, permanent hyphen lines and owner-bound edition/unit/section mappings. Homework and catalog-mapped progress require learningEntries; separately attributed teacher-reported progress may use exact user-supplied fact lines with the owner student bridge. Non-textbook activities such as 하브루타 use teacherReported {preserveBefore,mappedText,lines:[{factRef,text}]} on progress; every line must match a scoped user fact, while mappedText retains separately catalog-bound lines. Observation handles expire after 5 minutes and are invalid on scope/request or source/contract drift: run fresh intake and review, never reuse the old digest. questionCounts is for cardinal counts (8문항); 유형 10 is an ordinal and belongs in requiredFragments. A mismatch returns the field-local count_rendering_must_preserve_count hold. Parent safeguard excludes internal language including 채점, 검사 미완료 and 교사 완료판정 with parent_internal_language_excluded; preserve the confirmed stage and use supported wording such as 오답까지 완료. Semantic equivalence needs teacher review. No rewrite, save, send, approval consumption or automatic retry.

Academy routing context: DailyRecord 문안 검토·기존 문안과 변경 비교. Backend/source: DailyRecord field projection; qualified before-state when available. Review a proposed change without executing it. Current teacher facts and scoped corrections remain distinct from source observations.
End Academy routing context.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_save
tools.title: Save reviewed DailyRecord fields through the owner write backend
tools.description: Save only an exact reviewed patch. With the owner workflow (default for native launches), any delegated session may save when it supplies request.instruction with the verbatim user instruction behind this save and a prior academy_dailyrecord_review for this reviewDigest exists in the owner store. The bridge records the observed caller attribution and the caller may declare actor {runtime, sessionRef, paneRef, model}; both are audit evidence, not credentials. Writers serialize on a shared owner lock, the review is recomputed against a fresh before-state, each exact request/field transition is recorded once before dispatch, written once and read back. Duplicates report the recorded outcome; an unresolved dispatch on the same record field under any request is held for academy_dailyrecord_reconcile and never retried. A requestRef binds the first instruction text byte-for-byte: reuse that exact instruction on recovery; different text returns request_instruction_conflict. Do not change a requestRef to bypass an uncertain dispatch. The observation must be within 5 minutes and match the fresh current/previous targets, fields and source contract; stale_source/source_before_or_contract_drift require fresh intake and a new recorded review/digest before save. Parent safeguard still blocks 채점 and other internal language. Parent transmission is never part of a save.

tools.name: academy_dailyrecord_reconcile
tools.title: Reconcile uncertain DailyRecord dispatches by authoritative readback
tools.description: For one exact student/date record, read the current source once under the shared owner lock and classify every unresolved dispatch, under any request, as persisted, not_persisted or conflict. The new value closes a dispatch at once; the old or another value closes it only after a returned transport, because an uncertain request may still land at any later time. To close such an uncertain dispatch as not landed, pass resolution.request with the verbatim user instruction for the current requestRef and resolution.executions naming each {requestRef, field} to close on this exact lesson record (as listed by academy_dailyrecord_execution_status); it is recorded with who reconciled. Never writes to the academy, retries, rolls back or sends; a not_persisted or conflict field needs a new user request and review.
